title: Vibrant Roasted Canadian Turmeric Bread Flatbread
description: A keto-friendly Canadian dish featuring turmeric and double-rise bread, this flatbread is roasted to perfection and has a crumbly texture, making it an adventurous and delicious snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, turmeric powder, coconut flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, melted butter, and apple cider vinegar.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the flatbreads in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
